title: Dental clinic asks for its promised favicon
brief:
Client: Silver Sprout Dental; contact robin@example.com.
Design one selected logo from two initial concepts.
Supply full-colour SVG and PNG logo files.
Deliver one favicon as ICO and 32 × 32 px PNG files with the final logo package.
One revision round applies to the selected logo.
Concepts are due 20 October; the final package is due 27 October.
Out of scope: website design, animation and printed brochures.
message: Hi Pip, when do I get the favicon? I am checking our launch checklist for next week. Thank you!
